notes.title: Devlog #4 📚 Working on the Demo
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/286ce4d46726d686d8fe2adaefc46e6b25505a7c.png"][/img][/p][p]I am writing this in bed after dying at the gym. please clap[/p][p][/p][p]In case you just stumbled upon this, I am Adrienne, also known as insertdisc5! I am the creator of timeloop RPG[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677310/In_Stars_And_Time/?snr=1_5_9_"] [u]In Stars and Time[/u][/url], and now am working on my next game, memory visual novel[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239830?snr=1_5_9_"] [u]Truth Scrapper[/u][/url]. It’s gonna be a good one.[/p][p]This month, [b]I worked on the demo for Truth Scrapper!![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/dfc4ecfc91affe159420f1fa354908a8f72132dc.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The demo for Truth Scrapper is DONE!!![/b] (but you know I still need to get some people to playtest it and do some QA and we also need to translate it so really it’s not done but you know)[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, I thought I would go in a bit more detail about what a demo is, what it’s for, and how I go around making one.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]📚 WHAT'S A DEMO[/h2][p][/p][p]So, for the uninitiated, [b]a “demo” is a little slice of the game[/b], that is supposed to encapsulate the gameplay and story and stuff. It’s usually showcased in events like conventions (PAX, Gamescom…), and online (Steam events, especially Steam Next Fest). [b]The goal of a demo is to GET THOSE SWEET SWEET WISHLISTS BABYYYYY[/b][/p][p]
[/p][h2]📚 LEARNING FROM PAST MISTAKES[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/99725027f84b8b50c6095cccae9af67afa9fcb38.png"][/img][/p][p]When it comes to the [b]demo for In Stars and Time[/b] (my previous game), I think it did a great job showcasing both gameplay (through battles) and story (through events and dialogue). I ended up taking the first floor of the main dungeon, and fixing it up a bit so that the time loop starting was the Cool Thing at the end of the demo, and Loop’s appearance was the Cliffhanger. [b]Oh yeah your demo needs a cliffhanger[/b] so people go “oh my god i gotta know what happens next let me wishlist this.” So yes, I think I succeeded in that regard.[/p][p][/p][p]However, one big issue it had was the LENGTH. The demo was EASILY AN HOUR LONG, which is fine-ish when it comes to online demos (players have some time) and streamers (yay they get to play a game), but not great when it comes to conventions.[/p][p][/p][p]We only showcased the demo at the Tokyo Game Show, and I think in 3 days, only a handful of people played it from beginning to end. We ended up making a save skipping the first cutscene, and asking people if they wanted to see the story, or start from the gameplay, which is… Not great![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/9ce98f856d577e46d3d34d4db0538e3c59443eeb.png"][/img][/p][p]So for the Truth Scrapper demo, my goal was to make it [b]LESS THAN THIRTY MINUTES LONG[/b]. But also a piece of personal lore is that I am terrible at knowing how long a game I made is, so we’ll see if I succeed.[/p][p]
In positive things though, the ISAT demo allowed me to find some cute ways to make the full game more interesting, like tutorial fairy Loop being the one to tutorialize you at the start of the game! Originally, Loop just talked to you after your first loop, so they kind of came out of nowhere. Having a tutorial at the very start of the demo, then having that tutorial tell you to come to the tree was an idea I had for the demo, and it was so good I ended up adding it to the game! So hopefully, making the TS demo will also help me figure out some things…[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]📚 MAKING THE DEMO[/h2][p][/p][p]Ok so the one problem I had from the start was that in the full game, Day 1 is Amour’s day, and Day 2 is Betz’s. So obviously, I couldn’t just take either of those days as a base for the demo, since I wanted to showcase both characters immediately. Whole new day it is. [b]DAY… X!!!!!!!!!!![/b] (not canon to the full game.)[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/4f9faf38e3b0c299e7b61740ea633012b33dce63.png"][/img][/p][p]All days in TS usually follow this structure:[/p][p]Wake up -> Explore the town -> Explore the Dwell -> Point and Click investigation -> Dress-Up-type minigame -> End of the day.[/p][p]So I figured I would follow this for the demo, but, uh, immediately realized that would be a two hour demo. So I simplified it to this:[/p][p]Wake up (longest scene, needs to establish characters and setting) -> explore the Dwell (quickly) -> very quick Point and Click (“yahoo there’s gameplay”) -> Dress-Up-type minigame (it’s short and cute) -> End of the day (and cliffhanger).[/p][p]So most scenes are way quicker, and hopefully this will be a 30mn demo (GOD PLEASE I HOPE I’M RIGHT)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/2901c254df9c38a1d0ab0540bfc1924ea8533b22.png"][/img][/p][p]The demo also showcases the [b]memory gameplay[/b], where Sosotte gets to choose memories that give her specific “perks”. I originally had it just like the full game, where you can change those memories whenever, but I decided to make those permanent (you pick them at the start and they don’t change), which should allow for a certain level of replayability. And demo achievements. IF I CAN GET THEM TO WORK.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/73e3bd9ef19a31242cba7f1a9ae56d61aa1fc760.png"][/img][/p][p]Truth Scrapper has a lot of funny words and lore that would take longer than a demo to explain, so I also simplified the story there to make it more understandable. If some players want more details, there’s always the option for them to scour the [b]Glossary[/b]. This is honestly the biggest reason for playtesting, I really want to make sure I didn’t make the story too complex for the demo… We’ll find out…[/p][p] [/p][p]What else. Oh yeah. Since the demo is based on the latest Truth Scrapper build, I made sure to delete all mentions of stuff that happens later in the story. Yes including songs. Yes including sound effects. [b]YOU WON’T GET ME THIS TIME, CODE DIGGERS!!!!!!!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Uuuh yes that’s all. I know I said all of this and you don’t have the demo so you’re like “ok cool I guess that sounds great” so uh I hope you’ll play the demo when it comes out. Probably. Early 2026 or something.[/p][p][/p][h2]📚 HOLD UP HERES SOME ART[/h2][p][/p][p]Oh yeah... I also drew some art based on [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kbNdx0yqbZE"]this music video[/url]. You should really follow me on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/insertdisc5.com"]Bluesky[/url] or [url="https://insertdisc5.tumblr.com/"]Tumblr[/url] or even [url="https://www.instagram.com/insertdisc5/"]Instagram[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/5ea14777de6fb0c6a7c3144632468b9a6f7a9982.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/e6a1b89c554fd36b0f44d546cfd8451ca8b7cc54.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/6eb1895e72becb4f7a97d7fe4ead5dd7b09f3644.png"][/img][/p][p] ok thats it byyyyye[/p][p][/p][p]DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE GAME ALSO IT REALLY HELPS BECAUSE STEAM’S ALGORITHM IS MORE LIKELY TO SHOW OFF GAMES WITH A HIGH AMOUNT OF WISHLISTS THATS THE REASON WHY GAME DEVS ALWAYS ASK TO WISHLIST!!! OKAY BYE!!!![/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Links!

notes.title: Devlog #3 📚 Implementation
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/19939576061580b3574ad7aa109235f8ab4bddcf.png"][/img][/p][p]Hope everyone is once again staying cool in this dreadful summer.[/p][p][/p][p]In case you just stumbled upon this, I am Adrienne, also known as insertdisc5! I am the creator of timeloop RPG[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677310/In_Stars_And_Time/?snr=1_5_9_"] [u]In Stars and Time[/u][/url], and now am working on my next game, memory visual novel[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239830?snr=1_5_9_"] [u]Truth Scrapper[/u][/url]. It’s gonna be a good one.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]DAY 4 (out of 11-ish) IS FINALLY DONE AND IMPLEMENTED.[/b] This is the moment in the game where the story and character development picks up in a new way. And the Romance Sections are starting to get somewhere… It was so fun to get all this in the game![/p][p]
[/p][p][b]So… What does it mean to say that a day is “done and implemented”? Take my hand. I will explain.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][h3][u][b]WRITING:[/b][/u][/h3][p]
First is [b]writing the damn day[/b]. The first step of this first step is writing down bullet points of what happens during that day! What will happen? How does this further the mystery? How do the characters develop, and how does their relationship develop? Depending on what the player makes Sosotte remembers, will Sosotte be more attracted to Amour or Betz? In what way? Etc etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Once I have those bullet points written down, it’s time to actually write the scenes! Thankfully, I am getting to the Fun Parts of the game, so some of those Day 4+ scenes have been written down for a while. As I write, too, I usually realize I didn’t foreshadow some parts well enough, so I tend to rewrite some old scenes from previous days too. Day 1 has changed a lot since I first wrote it…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/cdd04f1e5d3ba191bdb60dc54b9f7f200686aa2a.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Part of my script. As you can tell, this has no caps because it's easier for me to write without thinking about it too much at this stage. I will regret it later)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This part takes me maybe… 3 weeks, a month? Longest part for sure.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][u][b]ART:[/b][/u][/h3][p]Now that I have all those scenes written out, I need to do ART!!! Thankfully, the artstyle for this game is pretty simple for me to do, and having the backgrounds be collages of stock pictures make the background work a breeze. Day 4 in particular was VERY HEAVY with art, so that one took some time. [b](20+ backgrounds, 2 new characters and their myriad of expressions, 20+ illustrations and all their variations…!!!)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/4a40a74848cb85ccda3a13c441f0c900da1811a0.png"][/img][i](This sweet thang is from Day 4)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This part takes me around 2 weeks![/p][p]
[/p][h3][u][b]IMPLEMENTATION:[/b][/u][/h3][p]Now that all the text is written, and the art has been done… [b]WE GOTTA ADD ALL THAT INTO THE GAME!!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I divide this work into a few parts:[/p][p][/p][p]-Add all the text and dialogue in the game, which means copy/paste, but also adding all those pesky quotes so the software can recognize this as text. I also add the character tags (here, “a” and “s”) to let Ren’py know who’s talking, as well as {w} to tell Ren’py “hey I want the player to have to press a button before the rest of the sentence appears”.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/369007c9ba81a2582ce93f67267cfe1dca3c2876.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-Add all the damn code. Which means: adding when a point and click section appears and how it works, adding any “if AmourPoints>BetzPoints then do this”, etc. [/p][p][/p][p]-Add all the expression changes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/de4dea9e2a98b4351e302ca7dc53610d2254989f.png"][/img][/p][p]So for the above, the white text can be translated as “Character Amour, side pose, eyes “hm”, mouth “eh”. Here’s Amour’s “callsaul” pose, named after a certain guy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/76b42c82aff16151048634af6d9c6207435c4acd.png"][/img][/p][p]During the implementation stage, adding expressions is the part that takes the longest amount of time by far.[/p][p][/p][p]-Add all the glossary/case entries. Truth Scrapper has many words and Sosotte needs to remember them all, and so the game has a glossary full of the many words, which needs to update as you find the new words.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/4adbb495cf4041b7814f8bafd46ea0718de3b3de.png"][/img][/p][p]-And finally, add all the music and sound effects. PHEW[/p][p][/p][p]This took a week this time because I exhausted myself doing it, but this usually takes me more like 2.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]EDITING:[/b][/u][/h3][p]
And then I usually spend a week or two playing through the ENTIRE game to make sure it’s good. I usually make a lot of edits, and so I have to play it through a second time, and a third time…[/p][p][/p][p]AND THEN WE’RE DONE. PHEW!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! This is how I go about things.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Anyway I finished Day 4 so I’m taking a break for a couple weeks. Heehee <3 Thanks for reading[/p][p][/p][p][b]DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE GAME ALSO IT REALLY HELPS BECAUSE STEAM’S ALGORITHM IS MORE LIKELY TO SHOW OFF GAMES WITH A HIGH AMOUNT OF WISHLISTS THATS THE REASON WHY GAME DEVS ALWAYS ASK TO WISHLIST!!! OKAY BYE!!!![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Links!

notes.title: Devlog #2 📚 Research Trip
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/0a362d82f0aa7aac13076ac79830317d37c403f7.png"][/img][/p][p]Already a month since the announcement?! Time passes by so fast. I hope everyone is staying cool in this dreadful weather.[/p][p][/p][p]In case you just stumbled upon this, I am Adrienne, also known as insertdisc5! I am the creator of timeloop RPG [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677310/In_Stars_And_Time/"]In Stars and Time[/url], and now am working on my next game, memory visual novel [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239830"]Truth Scrapper[/url]. It’s gonna be a good one.[/p][p][/p][p]This month, I [b]took a trip to Paris[/b], and [b]reworked the memory gameplay[/b] a bit![/p][p]  [/p][p]So, as you perhaps can tell, TS’s backgrounds are collages of photographs. I’ve been using royalty free images from websites like Pexels, and it’s been going relatively well. Unless I was looking for pictures of Paris that weren’t taken by tourists, or looking for pics of stairs taken from the top of the stairs for some reason.[/p][p][/p][p]In light of that, I decided to go on a trip to Paris for a couple weeks to take reference pictures <3[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/dd1673d5a70215cac76e9e4707542db2a3fb40d5.png"][/img][/p][p]Ok it might look like I only took pictures of food BUT IT’S RESEARCH OK IT’S RESEARCH OK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/319c911986a0e6fb7ce50f2458ec2753cfb4372c.png"][/img][i](Not an actual screenshot– this is how my illustration template is structured!)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The rest of the month was taken by rewrites and replays. Unlike with ISAT (my previous game) where I worked chronologically with minimal backtracking during development, I feel like for TS I keep going back to previous days to add things, change a scene, remove a bit of foreshadowing that was too obvious… It’s not a bad way of working, but it’s so different from what I’m used to that it stresses me out anyway!!! [/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/504beec1cf166c17bde62711cf692dd846ed7d05.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Old screenshot. The hardboiled eggs aren’t here anymore)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I also reworked the memory gameplay. [b]The only way to impact the story in TS is not through choices, but with which memories Sosotte decides to remember day-to-day.[/b] I originally had some memories be dud memories, or memories that are just here as flavor, but playtesters seemed to keep them anyway… So now, I’m making sure all memories will give you a little something something![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/c4d5d3f8b310864bd801b55431a6178454bf3881.png"][/img][/p][p]This is how the memories for the prologue look now. Note the icons! [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/e0682afe8e7c4984affd9ad6cf2b61a33a43bff6.png"][/img][/p][p]So, if you pick that “funny cloud” memory, you will gain the “sight” perk, which allows Sosotte to, uh, remember to use her eyes. Yippee![/p][p][/p][p]In July, I will finally finish that goshdang script for Day 4, and get it implemented. [/p][p][/p][p]kthnxbye[/p][p] [/p][p]DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE GAME ALSO IT REALLY HELPS BECAUSE STEAM’S ALGORITHM IS MORE LIKELY TO SHOW OFF GAMES WITH A HIGH AMOUNT OF WISHLISTS THATS THE REASON WHY GAME DEVS ALWAYS ASK TO WISHLIST!!! notes.title: Devlog #1 📚 The Very First Devlog
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/0597bf5cd59954ce484dc60fafb1336c7f0a4561.png[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewk20lm8M2I]We announced Truth Scrapper with a beautiful trailer this month!!![/url] The response has been absolutely incredible, thank you so much for following me on another funky memory adventure. Throughout the development of ISAT, I have written monthly devlogs on Steam, talking about the making of the game. People liked them a bunch, so...

That’s right. It’s time. For the Very First Truth Scrapper devlog!

In case you just stumbled upon this, I am Adrienne, also known as insertdisc5! I am the creator of timeloop RPG [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677310/In_Stars_And_Time/]In Stars and Time[/url], and now am working on my next game, memory visual novel Truth Scrapper. It’s gonna be a good one.

Alright! Development talk time. Where’s the game at?!?!

So, right now, I have just finished writing the script for Day 4, so I "only" have the art, code, and implementation to do for that day.
Truth Scrapper is divided in 7 days, with three different routes you can go through from Day 6 onwards. So really, I need to write and code 11 days. Which puts me at almost ⅓ through development! WOAHRGH!??!
At this point, I know where the story is going, I know what each route will consist of, etc. I just don’t know the Details. The portraits are all done, backgrounds are done sequentially for every day, gameplay is all figured out…
[b]TLDR: It’s In Good Shape!!![/b]

[b]“That was a good short paragraph, but can I have the detailed timeline of the game. Please.”[/b]
ok fine you asked for it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/2680c83bc6d0704c7a0684bd76021c44bc94fb29.png[/img]
📚 this image was made so early in development, it didn't even have Betz's shibari-like pink harness

[h3]TRUTH SCRAPPER TIMELINE[/h3]

DEC 2022: I finish ISAT around NOV 2022. I get an idea. I write it down. It was going to be an RPG but nobody got time for that. Main themes and ending are here. I work on pre-production very slowly over the next couple months (because I am recovering from finishing ISAT and still gotta keep working on post-production stuff for ISAT)

JULY 2023: Ok fine let's make a renpy file and figure out if the most important gameplay thing can be done. AKA: can I make a book menu where the game remembers the choices you make, and how complicated is that gonna be for me to add to it down the line. It works and I am happy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/deb0b360f5d0e5b476b2d7023313392999eb5bf5.png[/img]
📚 this image was made so early in development, it just looks very bad

AUGUST 2023: Character design. They look Not Great and character design takes me like nine months. Plot is getting somewhere though!

NOV 2023: In Stars and Time comes out. People like it I think.

MARCH 2024: I decide I need to work on something, and decide to work on that and apply for the Ontario Creates grant. This game is actually starting for realsies!!!!!!!

MAY 2024: I actually lock down character designs. 

JUNE 2024: I hire Dora, who was the producer of In Stars and Time and who rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/a340f3a610debe5612b72272825396fe9c0ca2f6.png[/img]
📚 dora and i signing our lives to one another on discord. the bond between a creator and their producer can never be broken

SEPT 2024: I work on da gaem

MAY 2025: Day 3 is implemented. We announce the game. Now we’re here!!!!

Alright, that’s it for today! This first devlog is more about telling you where the game is at, and every month you will have a whole new devlog where I can tell you about all the great things I did that month for the game. You can even comment with questions and I might answer them one day. Ok. Thank you. And as always,
DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE GAME ALSO IT REALLY HELPS BECAUSE STEAM’S ALGORITHM IS MORE LIKELY TO SHOW OFF GAMES WITH A HIGH AMOUNT OF WISHLISTS THATS THE REASON WHY GAME DEVS ALWAYS ASK TO WISHLIST!!! OKAY BYE!!!!

notes.title: Truth Scrapper REAL!!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ewk20lm8M2I;full][/previewyoutube]

IT’S HERE!!! My next game Truth Scrapper is here it’s announced I can talk about it I am FREE.

I’ve been working on this game pretty much since I finished developing In Stars and Time, and I am SO HAPPY to finally be able to share it with all of you. I hope you will enjoy meeting Sosotte, Betz, and Amour, and I’m excited to show you even more about them and the game as development continues! Until release, I’ll be posting regular updates and devlogs, so watch this space (or sign up for my newsletter) (or both)

I know you have some questions. Here are some answers.

[h2]Is Truth Scrapper related to your previous game, In Stars and Time?[/h2]
Nope! Truth Scrapper is a whole new game, in a whole new setting! Of course, as you will discover, they will share many themes, but that’s just because I made it. I’m very grateful for the whole lot of love people have given Siffrin and the gang, and I hope in time you’ll find a spot in your heart for my terrible terrible girls.

[h2]Betz uses he/they! Are they a girl?[/h2]
The three of them are some flavor of genderfluid. They are not necessarily women. But they are Girls. To me
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/406d9faeb98fc29eee43a08034e1163d5f40a56e.png[/img]

[h2]What do you mean by “toxic lesbians”?[/h2]
Ok so Truth Scrappers will not contain any explicit “adult” content or graphic gore/violence (sorry). However, it IS a game about complicated, messy characters, who do not always make the best choices for themselves and others. They are NOT trying to get a good grade in therapy. I’m not sure therapy even exists where they live

[h2]Who is working on this game?[/h2]
Me (insertdisc5) <3. I made in Stars and Time, Serre, and also many comics. I am the sole full time developer, artist, and writer.
I am thankfully also supported by several wonderful partners! With me on this project are  sound designers Level Curve, composer Jess Forrest (aka CastleIF), marketing geniuses CONTINUE, and producer Dora Breckinridge, who you may know as the producer of In Stars and Time, and who loves Betz oh-so-much, so you know Betz is gonna go through some shit because I love torturing Dora oh-so-much.

[h2]Is it coming to any other platforms?[/h2]
Not as present! It is currently only planned for PC, and I am a solo, self-published dev, so I’m being mindful about my time and other resources. That’s not to say it’s off the table though.

[h2]What languages will Truth Scrapper be in?[/h2]
I would LOVE to localize Truth Scrapper in a few more languages, but I am also a big yapper and localized words cost money. We will be exploring our options throughout development, but we cannot guarantee anything!

[h2]When is Truth Scrapper coming out?[/h2]
When it’s done babey. (Don’t expect it any time soon)

[h2]How can I support the game?[/h2]
WISHLIST TRUTH SCRAPPER ON STEAM!!! This is by far one of the biggest, easiest things you can do to have an impact on the game’s success and visibility on Steam. And of course, if you like the game, be sure to follow us using the links below, and share the news… Tell your friends… Thank you… Talk to you soon…
